message.content:
**Highest‑grossing film ever (worldwide)**  
As of the most recent publicly available figures — and according to major industry trackers such as Box Office Mojo and The Numbers — **“Avatar” (2009) directed by James Cameron** remains the top‑earning motion picture globally, pulling in roughly **$2.93 billion USD** at the worldwide box office.

> *Key points:*  
> • “Avatar” surpassed previous leaders like *Titanic* (1997) and *Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens* (2015).  
> • Its record has held despite multiple re‑releases (notably the 2020 IMAX/4K version) which added further earnings.  
> • Some analysts adjust for inflation or ticket price changes; when those factors are applied, older films sometimes climb higher on adjusted charts, but the raw dollar total still places “Avatar” first.

If you’re interested in more detailed breakdowns (domestic vs international splits, per‑screen averages, etc.) let me know!
